event_summary: A flame flickers on the top of a white roll while smoke appears and a dark patch on the roll's top surface enlarges.
raw_event_description: A white cylindrical roll with a hollow center lies horizontally on a small dark support against a black background. At the start, an orange flame is already present on the upper surface of the roll. Through the sequence, the flame changes height and shape, pale smoke wisps appear above and to the side of it, and a dark area on the roll's top surface becomes larger and darker. The roll, support, and loose sheet extending from the roll remain in the same visible positions.

reasons: The flame is already visible at the first frame.
The roll, hollow opening, loose sheet, support, flame, and dark background are visible.
